summary: Hamas formally declared on April 23 that insisting on disarmament without fulfilling Phase One ceasefire obligations 'contradicts Trump's own plan,' deepening the negotiation deadlock as two Board of Peace deadlines (Apr 14, Apr 19) have passed without agreement.
